target_customer: Developers building computer use agents and automation (open source), originally web data extraction users
problem: Automating web tasks like data extraction and form filling needs brittle scripts. Bytebot used AI, later as an open source containerized desktop for AI agents with mouse, keyboard and screenshot APIs.
business_model: Open source with free self-hosting; paid offering unclear

founders.name: Carl Atupem
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no further background

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser automation with AI was feasible for a small team in 2021, with harder parts in reliability. The later desktop agent version is more complex.

defensibility.rationale: Open source under Apache 2.0 and many automation tools existed, so copying was easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy found. A PitchBook profile lists acquisition by Standard Fleet on 2025-12-15, single source and unconfirmed.

market_need_then: Demand for no-code web automation and scraping existed in 2021, but no dated evidence on Bytebot's own demand was found.

branding.community_and_virality: Site claims a Discord community and an open source GitHub repo; counts not verified

brand_strength.rationale: A GitHub repo and docs site exist with a Discord claimed by the site, but no press about the brand was found and the name is generic.

pivots.from: AI web data extraction and form filling
pivots.to: Open source container for AI desktop agents
pivots.why: Not stated; YC page and site show the two descriptions

outcome_analysis: Bytebot began in YC Summer 2021 as an AI web automation tool with a team of three and a small convertible note from Y Combinator and angels. It later repositioned as an open source desktop agent container under Tantl Labs. YC lists it as acquired and PitchBook gives December 2025 and Standard Fleet, but no press confirms it, so the cause and terms of the exit are unknown.
notes: CB Insights lists a 0.5 million dollar convertible note dated 2021-01 from Y Combinator, Jude Gomilla and SB Opportunity Fund; single aggregator and the date precedes the batch, so recorded here as unverified and not as a round. Acquirer and date come from one PitchBook snippet only. CB Insights treats the company as alive. Competitor list empty: searches returned only undated current comparison pages. Pivot date unknown. Name origin not found. Website is copyright Tantl Labs 2025. Both rounds rest on a single database each (CB Insights convertible note, PitchBook seed of 125K in Aug 2021); they may describe the same financing and the two disagree on amount and date. No press or filing confirms either.
